messages:
Ava Chen: @here Quick heads-up — next company all-hands is Friday Apr 29, 10:00am PT. Please drop agenda items or questions in this thread by Thursday EOD. We'll cover product roadmap highlights, Dedicated launch timing, Private deployment updates, and Q2 hiring priorities. :loudspeaker:

Zoe Martinez: Agenda draft below — feel free to suggest edits or add time estimates. I'll lock it tomorrow.
```
1) CEO update (Ava) — 10 min
2) Product roadmap & Dedicated status (Marcus) — 12 min
3) Private deployment & compliance (Priya) — 8 min
4) Ops metrics + reliability (Eng SRE) — 7 min
5) Hiring & org updates (Ravi) — 6 min
6) Q&A — 17 min
```

Marcus Li: Running list of things I'll surface: Dedicated GA timeline, perf baselines vs hosted, and a short demo of the rollout dashboard. If you have a customer anecdote I should call out, drop it here.

Priya Patel: For Private: quick summary of on-prem packaging + KMS/HSM roadmap. Note: staging for enterprise partners is scheduled the week after the all-hands.

Ravi Singh: Logistics: we'll stream via Meet; captioning on. If you need time off to attend (timezone), talk to your manager — we'll record and post link. Also send any sensitive Qs to me privately if you prefer.

Jordan Kim: Heads-up for folks on design — we'll have 30s of slides for the UX changes to the Console. Upload to the shared deck by Thursday 5pm PT.

Tess Rivera: I'll take notes and publish a short write-up after. If anyone wants a short quote from leadership for their partner calls, DM me. :memo:

Ava Chen: Please add any burning questions. A couple of prompts to help teams: "What risk areas should we prioritize for Dedicated GA?" and "What features in Console make the biggest difference for your customers?"

Marcus Li: Q: can we call out the new SLA plan in the all-hands or keep it to customers first?

Ava Chen: We'll mention high-level SLA commitments in the all-hands and follow with targeted comms for affected customers the same day.

Zoe Martinez: Reminder: submit slides to #all-hands-slides (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/example) and use the template.

Employee (sneak): Is there time for a quick community spotlight (1–2 min)? We have a great case study from a small fintech.

Priya Patel: Yes — Marcus, if you want to call it out during product update, we can slot 2 minutes.

Ravi Singh: Note on accommodations — if you need childcare reimbursement or timezone flexibility to attend, reply to me privately and we'll coordinate.

Jordan Kim: Slide upload done (v3). Added demo screenshots and two customer quotes.

Ava Chen: Thanks — final agenda will be posted tomorrow. Also, if folks want to pre-submit long/technical Qs, please use this short form so we can triage: https://forms.gle/example-allhands-questions

allhands-bot: Meeting created: "All-Hands — Apr 29" • Google Meet link has been sent to calendar invites. Recording will be auto-saved to the All-Hands folder.

Tess Rivera: Quick FYI — we'll run an internal poll after the meeting for feedback. Takes 30s, helps us shape future sessions.

Marcus Li: One more ask — if anyone from customer-facing teams can surface one or two top customer asks for Dedicated (pricing, isolation, SLAs), post them here by EOD Thursday.

Ava Chen: Thank you — appreciate the quick turn. See you all Friday. :rocket:

allhands-bot: Recording uploaded: https://drive.google.com/recording/example-apr29 — notes + highlights will be posted in this channel within 24 hours.

Tess Rivera: Post-meeting takeaways (draft):
- Dedicated GA timeline confirmed for mid-May
- Private on-prem staging next week for enterprise partners
- SLA commitments announced, customer comms planned same-day
- UX tweaks to Console prioritized based on customer feedback
- Hiring: 6 new roles approved (infra, SRE, product)

Priya Patel: Follow-up: we'll open a beta cohort for 5 partners — sign-up sheet coming from eng-ml.

Ravi Singh: Action: people-ops to run two hiring Q&A sessions next week — calendar invites out by EOD.

Ava Chen: Thanks everyone for the great questions and the prep. If you want something called out in the public blog post about the Dedicated GA, DM me or Tess.

Marcus Li: Adding final note — appreciate the tight feedback loop from product & sales on perf targets. :clap:
